name: Ida
title: Salvewright
examine: Trained on Elowen's folios, came south for what ash does to a miner's chest. Keeps a list of every remedy that failed. It is long, and it is also a map.
lines: Breathe for me. In. Out. You will live, which is my whole trade.
Salve for burns, draught for the lungs, and sleep for most of the rest.
My list of failures is long. It is also a map.
